text: The 432Hz reference means that the recording has been retuned so that the note A above middle C corresponds to approximately 432 cycles per second instead of the modern standard of 440Hz. The other notes are adjusted proportionally, so it does not mean that every sound in the music is 432Hz. This makes the music sound slightly lower and warmer. Some people listen to 432Hz music because it is said to have healing effects, but these claims have not been scientifically proven.
